queries.name: command-queue
queries.subject: Show the durable local CLI command queue.
queries.objective: Inspect command lifecycle and reconnect to output without rerunning work.
queries.acceptance: Preserve persistent command IDs and all six server states; closing output never cancels execution. Unavailable local authority is not an empty queue.

queries.name: command-queue-summary
queries.subject: Report the command queue's server-owned running count and pause reason.
queries.objective: Expose active work and admission pauses without counting a paginated browser result.
queries.acceptance: Use the authoritative running and total counts, not a row count; missing authority remains unavailable.

pages.title: Commands
pages.description: Durable local commands. Closing a terminal detaches; use Cancel command to stop work.

views.title: Running commands
views.description: Show the authoritative running count independently of server-paginated history.

views.title: Queue admission
views.description: Server-owned admission pauses and total count remain visible even when history is filtered.

views.title: Command queue
views.description: Inspect persistent command status and open replayable output; list filters and pages execute on the local server through the data worker.

views.title: Command output
views.description: Interaction-only terminal replay, explicit cancellation and retry cannot be expressed by evidence marks. Lifecycle and streamed output use worker transport; closing or navigating away only detaches.
